paper_title: Constraining hidden photons via atomic force microscope measurements and the Plimpton-Lawton experiment
notes: Paper derives new laboratory limits on hidden-photon kinetic mixing chi from (1) reanalysis of AFM Casimir-force measurements and (2) the 1936 Plimpton-Lawton concentric-shell Coulomb-law test. No numerical table is provided; the emitted data points are the Plimpton-Lawton exclusion curve (purple in Figs. 1 & 7), computed from the paper's closed-form Eq. (26) with the stated parameters R*=0.61 m, R=0.76 m, sensitivity gamma=3.3e-10. Curve minimum chi~8e-5 near m~1e-6 eV; low-mass cutoff ~0.02 neV and high-mass reach chi=1 near ~4e2 eV, consistent with the paper's stated asymptotics and Fig. 7. The weaker AFM bound (chi >~ 10^-0.5 over 0.1-10 eV) is subsumed by the Plimpton-Lawton bound in the overlap region and is not included. Projected improvements (Figs. 6, 8) are excluded. Not a DM haloscope; no DM density assumed.
